desc: Derive factoring approach: d = x−y must divide N with d³ < N, so trial division up to 10⁶ suffices.
Establish discriminant test: D = 12m − 3d² perfect square, (s − 3d) > 0 and divisible by 6 gives y.
Write the complete Python solution with solve(), stdin/stdout handling, math.isqrt, and the divisor loop; enclose in required code delimiters.
Sanity-check edge cases mentally: N=1 → -1 (loop body never runs), d³ = N exactly excluded (y=0), large N like sample 3.
